tool_calls.name:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os
p = Path('pipeline/workflow.go')
s = p.read_text()
for old, new in [('LoadInput', 'ReadRequest'), ('CheckInput', 'ValidateRequest'), ('NormalizeValue', 'CanonicalizeValue'), ('MapFields', 'ProjectFields')]:
    s = s.replace(old, new)
tmp = p.with_name(p.name + '.tmp')
with tmp.open('w') as f:
    f.write(s)
    f.flush()
    os.fsync(f.fileno())
os.replace(tmp, p)
PY
go test ./..."
